column1: # Penjelasan crash berdasarkan bukti: RAM hanya disalahkan bila ada buktinya.
Crash tidak selalu berarti launcher-nya rusak, dan tidak selalu karena RAM. Penyebabnya bisa mod, versi Java, driver grafis, atau memori. Cari tahu dulu sebelum melapor ke pengembang.
column2: A crash does not always mean the launcher is broken, and it is not always because of RAM. The cause can be a mod, the Java version, the graphics driver, or memory. Find out first before reporting to the developer.

column1: Game dihentikan karena HP kehabisan memori (tercatat oleh Android atau di log). Biasanya bukan kerusakan launcher. Coba kurangi alokasi RAM game (jangan lebih dari setengah RAM HP), kurangi mod, dan tutup aplikasi lain.
column2: The game was stopped because the phone ran out of memory (recorded by Android or in the log). This is usually not a launcher fault. Try lowering the game's RAM allocation (no more than half of the phone's RAM), removing some mods, and closing other apps.

column1: Log menunjukkan memori yang dijatahkan untuk game sudah habis. Ini bukan berarti RAM HP kurang. Biasanya karena jarak render terlalu jauh, terlalu banyak mod, atau shader. Coba kurangi jarak render, kurangi mod, atau matikan shader. Kalau RAM HP masih lega, alokasi RAM game boleh dinaikkan sedikit di Pengaturan > Memori.
column2: The log shows that the memory set aside for the game ran out. This does not mean the phone has too little RAM. It is usually caused by a render distance that is too high, too many mods, or shaders. Try lowering the render distance, removing some mods, or turning shaders off. If the phone still has plenty of RAM, you can raise the game's RAM allocation a little in Settings > Memory.

column1: Proses game dimatikan paksa, dan log tidak menyebut sebabnya. Ini belum tentu karena RAM: bisa juga karena aplikasi ditutup dari daftar aplikasi terbaru, dimatikan penghemat baterai, atau sistem sedang kekurangan memori. Coba jalankan lagi tanpa membuka aplikasi lain. Kalau terus terulang, salin log untuk AI.
column2: The game process was force-stopped, and the log does not say why. This is not necessarily because of RAM: the app may also have been closed from the recent apps list, killed by battery saver, or the system may have been short on memory. Try launching again without opening other apps. If it keeps happening, copy the log for AI.

column1: Proses game terhenti mendadak, penyebabnya tidak tercatat (bisa dihentikan sistem, ditutup dari luar, atau crash di kode native).
column2: The game process stopped suddenly and the cause was not recorded (it may have been stopped by the system, closed from outside, or crashed in native code).
